purpose: Auditable source references for benchmark Minds; source text is not copied into LMP artifacts.

sources.claim: Use explicit static typing and compiler-supported design feedback.
Prefer explicit boundaries and avoid unsafe dynamic execution.
Keep routing and middleware behavior explicit and composable.
Use small runtime-aware handlers and platform capabilities.
Put tenant authorization at the data boundary.
Prefer readable, unsurprising, maintainable implementation choices.
Review design, tests, maintainability, and overall code health.
Use real implementation and contributor practice as evidence, not invented examples.
Use documented engineering methodology and explain trade-offs through maintainable guidance.
Use public Rust project design and maintenance discussions as source material, not as an endorsement of an LMP profile.
Use ownership, type-directed correctness, and explicit error handling as observable Rust practices.
Use clear, idiomatic Go composition, naming, formatting, and explicit error handling.
Use measured runtime performance and a strong local-to-production development loop as an engineering consideration.
Use inspectable, composable UI primitives with explicit accessibility and interaction states.
Use declarative, reproducible infrastructure and make operational drift visible.
